# CoverAI – Compressed Interactive Element Map
## Generated by Playwright QA harness

### App: http://localhost:3000 | API: http://localhost:8000/api/v1
### Roles: customer, insurer_officer, advisor

---

## Auth Pages

### /login
```
form > #email[type=email] + #password[type=password] + button[type=submit]("Sign In")
link → /register ("Create an account")
```

### /register
```
form > #fullName[type=text] + #email[type=email] + #phone[type=tel]
     + #role[select: customer|advisor|insurer_officer]
     + #password[type=password] + button[type=submit]("Sign Up")
link → /login ("Sign In")
pw-checks: hasMinLength(8) + hasUppercase + hasDigit
phone-check: /^[6-9]\d{9}$/ (Indian mobile)
```

---

## Customer Portal (role=customer)

### /dashboard
```
sidebar: nav > [Dashboard, My Policies, File a Claim, My Claims, Help]
         button("Sign Out")
hero: h1("Hello, {name}")
tabs: button[vault|ai|claims|privacy]
  vault: grid > policy-cards → router.push('/policies/{id}')
  ai: select#policy-select + chat-input + send-button
  claims: grid > claim-cards with timeline stepper
  privacy: consent toggles + data export/deletion buttons
```

### /policies
```
button("Upload New Policy" | "Upload Now") → opens upload-modal
upload-modal: input[type=file] + #insurerName + #vehicleReg + button[type=submit]
policy-list: a[href="/policies/{id}"] cards
```

### /policies/[id]
```
policy detail view + AI Q&A chat
input[placeholder*="Ask a policy question"] + button[type=submit]
```

### /claims/new (multi-step wizard)
```
step1: grid > button (policy selection cards) + button("Continue")
step2: #incident_date + #incident_location + button("Own Damage"|"Third Party"|"Theft")
       + #incident_description(textarea,min50) + button("Continue")
step3: input[type=file] (image upload) + button("Continue")
step4: review summary + button("Submit Claim")
→ redirect to /claims/{uuid}
```

### /claims
```
claim list with claim_number, status, timeline stepper
button → router.push('/claims/{id}')
```

### /claims/[id]
```
claim detail: status, risk score, AI triage assessment
```

## API Endpoints (key auth routes)
```
POST /auth/register   {email,phone,password,full_name,role}
POST /auth/login      {email,password} → set cookies: access_token(HttpOnly), refresh_token
POST /auth/logout     → clear cookies
GET  /auth/me         → user profile
POST /auth/refresh    → refresh access_token

GET  /policies
POST /policies (upload)
GET  /policies/{id}

POST /claims          → create claim
GET  /claims          → list user claims
GET  /claims/{id}     → claim detail

GET  /claims/insurer/queue  → insurer unassigned claims
POST /claims/{id}/assign-self
PATCH /claims/{id}/status

GET  /consent
PATCH /consent/{type}
POST /data-export
POST /data-deletion
```

---

## Cookie Architecture
- `access_token` – HttpOnly JWT, 15min TTL, carries auth
- `refresh_token` – non-HttpOnly indicator ("authenticated"), 7d TTL, used by Next.js middleware
- `user_role` – non-HttpOnly, set by client JS, used by middleware for role-based redirect
